scripts.android:sync: npm run build && cap sync android
scripts.android:bundle: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('android/keystore.properties')) { console.error('Missing android/keystore.properties. Configure your upload key before building.'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: node -e "if (!require('fs').existsSync('android/keystore.properties')) { console.error('Missing android/keystore.properties. Configure your upload key before building.'); process.exit(1); }" && npm run android:sync && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
